title: PH Embassy warns Filipinos in Italy of possible protests, public disturbances
summary: The Philippine Embassy in Rome has urged Filipinos in Italy to exercise heightened caution as demonstrations and public disturbances are expected in several Italian cities on Saturday, October 24.
